author: GavinNewsom
text:
MAGA sheriffs CANNOT seize ballots in California. Period.

The California Supreme Court just affirmed that democracy is alive and well in our state. And, the new laws I just signed last week provide additional protections so politicians can't attempt to take your vote away.

Voting in California is safe and secure and we're going to keep it that way.
